verdict.rationale: Pulumi ships AI features (Neo, an MCP server) and a hosted Pulumi Cloud service, so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question for this product. The evidence pack has no documented setting, policy, or contractual commitment that prevents customer data from being used to train AI models. DIY state backends and self-hosting are adjacent data-location options, not a training opt-out, so they earn no credit.
